verdict.rationale: Monday documents official SDKs/tooling for AI-native builders: a GraphQL API, an 'apps framework' for code-first development, an open-source React component library (Vibe) for native-looking UI, and a documented developer MCP server for scaffolding/deploying agents. Together these constitute a real official SDK/toolchain for building AI-native apps and agents on the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality or adoption, and llms.txt returns 404 suggesting incomplete AI-facing doc tooling.
